files.newFile: Context-menu item that creates an empty file
files.newFolder: Context-menu item that creates an empty folder
files.setMain: Marks this file as the document the compiler builds
files.setMainFailed: Error after the user picks Set as main document in the file tree and the project refuses it
files.unreadable: Short label at the end of a file tree row the app has no permission to read
files.listingStopped: Quiet note under the file tree when a very large opened folder was only partly listed
files.confirmTrash: Confirmation before moving a file or folder to the macOS or Linux Trash
files.confirmTrashWindows: Confirmation before moving a file or folder to the Windows Recycle Bin
files.partialFolder: Tooltip on a folder in the file tree, and a note inside it when expanded, when a very large opened folder was listed only in part

outline.title: Panel heading listing the headings of the open document

structure.title: Panel heading listing the files and symbols of the whole project

terminal.activity: Screen-reader text for the dot on a terminal tab or the toolbar's terminal button after a program rang the terminal bell while it was hidden

clipboard.blocked: Toast when a program in the terminal asked to copy text and the system needs a click first; the button copies it

find.count: Find bar position, for example "3 of 12"
find.label: Accessible name and placeholder of the search box that finds text in the terminal's output

launch.invalid: Shown when another feature asked to run a command in the terminal and the command or its settings were not allowed
launch.noProject: Shown when a terminal was requested while no project is open; terminals always run inside a project folder
launch.run: Confirm button of the dialog shown before Oleafly types a prepared command into a new terminal tab
launch.title: Asked before Oleafly types a command another feature prepared, such as an installer or a sign-in command, into a new terminal tab

terminal.openInTerminal: Menu item on a folder in the file tree that opens a terminal tab starting in that folder

stop.closeMany: Confirm button of the dialog shown before stopping programs that run in the terminal
stop.closeOne: Confirm button of the dialog shown before stopping a program that runs in the terminal
stop.closeProject: Confirm button of the dialog shown before stopping programs that run in the terminal, when the user closes the project
stop.dontAsk: Checkbox in the dialog shown before stopping programs that run in the terminal; it turns the question off
stop.many_one: {{count}} is the number of terminal tabs that still run a program
stop.many_other: {{count}} is the number of terminal tabs that still run a program
stop.named: {{process}} is a program name such as python or node; {{title}} is a terminal tab name such as "Terminal 2"
stop.quit: Confirm button of the dialog shown before stopping programs that run in the terminal, when the user quits the app
stop.restart: Confirm button of the dialog shown before stopping programs that run in the terminal, when the app restarts to install an update
stop.switchProject: Confirm button of the dialog shown before stopping programs that run in the terminal, when the user opens another project
stop.unnamed: {{title}} is a terminal tab name such as "Terminal 2"; the program's name is unknown

terminal.color: Submenu that tints a terminal tab

links.openFile: Hint under a file location in the terminal tooltip. {{modifier}} is the key symbol or name: ⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere
links.openUrl: Hint under a web address in the terminal tooltip. {{modifier}} is the key symbol or name: ⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere. The link opens in the system web browser
links.openUrlFailed: Error toast when a web address clicked in the terminal could not be opened in the system browser

terminal.tabs: Accessible name of the terminal tab strip

tree.clearFilter: Clears the text typed in the tree filter box
